exifr 7.1.3, full UMD browser build, MIT license (see exifr-LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/exifr/-/exifr-7.1.3.tgz

Bundled locally so photo metadata extraction does not depend on a CDN.
The full build supports JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF, and PNG EXIF GPS metadata.
